Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: South
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 02/28/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 385 as introduced would exempt homeless students from paying certain issuance fees for a drivers license ($20.50), duplicate license ($15), or the drivers license examination ($5), which would decrease receipts to the various funds below by the following estimated maximum amounts based on the total number of homeless students enrolled in public schools: 1) State General Fund: $35,964; 2) Highway Safety Fund: $9,720; 3) Probate Judges: $2,916; and 4) Alabama Veterans Legacy Trust Fund: $972, for a total of $49,572. The receipts to these funds could further decrease by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of private school students that seek an exemption from drivers license fees as provided by this bill.
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund
